question: The perimeter of an isosceles triangle is 184 cm. If the base is 44 cm, find the length of the equal sides (in cm).
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Perimeter** of **isosceles triangle** = 2 × **Equal side** + **Base**

2 × **Equal side** = 184 − 44 = 140 cm

**Equal side** = 140 ÷ 2 = 70 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 70 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Perimeter** (P) = 184 cm

**Base** (b) = 44 cm

**Formula Used:**

**Perimeter** of **Isosceles Triangle** = 2a + b (where a is the **equal side**)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3ccdf6ccd5c86595d1a97ea20a50b1cbbdeb507552ca7671a2bcd0bfd0bb0c1f.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 184 = 2a + 44

⇒ 2a = 184 − 44

⇒ 2a = 140

⇒ a = 140 ÷ 2

⇒ a = 70 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 70 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Area of Isosceles Triangle

Area = (b ÷ 4) × √(4a² − b²), where a is the **equal side** and b is the **base**.

Equilateral Triangle

All three sides are equal. **Perimeter** = 3 × side and **Area** = (√3 ÷ 4) × side².

Triangle Inequality Theorem

The sum of any two sides of a **triangle** must be greater than the third side (a + a > b ⇒ 2a > b).</p
